$description: Filters applied to the OpenAPI spec before SDK generation. `hiddenFields` is schema-name -> property names to omit from generated models and types. `excludedPaths` is a list of globs matched against OpenAPI path keys. A pattern with no wildcards is an exact match. `*` covers one path segment and `**` covers one or more nested segments; it does not match the path without those segments. Brace expansion is disabled so `{uuid}` stays literal. Remove an entry here to re-expose a field or endpoint.
